beginning.title: The Beginning
beginning.description1: Padungsilpa Group started its fuel station business in 1964 under the name Padungsilpa Engineering Limited Partnership, founded by Mr. Amnuay Sinsamutphadung, who had extensive experience and expertise in construction work.
beginning.description2: In the early days of business operations, the company focused on providing construction and installation services for various systems in fuel stations, particularly the installation of fuel tanks and fuel piping systems.

expansion.title: Business Expansion
expansion.description1: In 1977, the company expanded its scope of operations and transformed into Padungsilpa Engineering Co., Ltd. to accommodate business growth and more diverse services.
expansion.description2: The business expansion during this period enabled the company to take on larger projects and began developing expertise in modern fuel storage technology.

innovation.title: Innovation & Technology
innovation.description1: The company imported PERMATANK® technology from Germany, which is a high-standard and safe underground fuel tank system, making the company a leader in fuel storage technology in Thailand.
innovation.description2: With over 50 years of experience, we are ready to provide comprehensive services from design, construction, system installation, and maintenance to fully meet customer needs.

pipeInstallation.title: Double-Wall Underground Piping
pipeInstallation.description: Underground fuel piping system that prevents leaks with real-time leak detection system
pipeInstallation.detailedDescription: With over 20 years of experience in double-wall fuel pipe installation, Padungsilpa Engineering Co., Ltd. is an authorized distributor and installer of NUPIGECO S.P.A. brand fuel pipes, Smartflex and Ecoflex models, manufactured in Italy. Made from Polyethylene (PE) and Polyamide (PA) materials with special properties to prevent fuel leaks and can detect leaks in real-time. This piping system is certified to European Standard EN 14125 and tested in various environments, ensuring maximum durability and safety. With installation teams trained directly by the product owner, with experience in over 300 projects.

environmentHealthDrugPolicy.heroTitle: Environment, Health, Safety and Drug Policy PADUNGSILPA GROUP
environmentHealthDrugPolicy.heroSubtitle: It is Padungsilpa Group's policy to conduct its business in a manner that protects the safety of employees, others involved in its operations, customers and the public. Our group of companies will strive to prevent all accidents, injuries and occupational illnesses through the active participation of every employee. Our group of companies are committed to continuous efforts to identify and eliminate or manage safety risks associated with its activities.

occupationalHealth.title: Occupational Health Policy
points: Prevent employees from experiencing work-related illnesses under any circumstances.|
Promote employee health and prevent actions that may harm customers, contractors, or stakeholders.|
Maintain workplace hygiene and safety at all times.

safety.title: Safety Policy
points: Operate in a way that ensures maximum safety for employees, stakeholders, customers, and the public.|
Prevent accidents, injuries, and illnesses through active employee engagement.|
Continuously identify, eliminate, or control any safety risks associated with business operations.

drug.title: Drug Policy
points: Monitor and strictly prevent employees from using, possessing, distributing, or selling illegal substances or misusing drugs inside or outside the workplace.|
Prohibit the consumption of alcohol or any substances that impair employees' work performance, ensuring workplace safety and efficiency.|
Provide assistance to employees struggling with substance dependency, facilitating immediate access to treatment before work performance is affected.

environmental.title: Environmental Policy
points: Commit to responsible environmental practices that meet or exceed industry standards while continuously improving our sustainability efforts.|
Encourage all employees to care for and respect the environment, emphasizing that environmental responsibility is a shared duty.
